articles.title: NASA’s Chandra Rings in New Year With Champagne Cluster
articles.summary: Celebrate the New Year with the “Champagne Cluster,” a galaxy cluster seen in this new image from NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory and optical telescopes. Astronomers discovered this galaxy cluster Dec. 31, 2020. articles.title: Isaacman opens door to alternatives to moving shuttle Discovery to Houston
articles.summary:
